The transition from the chin/neck to the black clothing is somewhat indistinct and muddy. The anatomy of the neck seems slightly compressed or obscured by the shadow/hair overlap.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'curls'. In AI images, complex curls often merge into each other losing individual strand definition. Check if the 'ringlets' are distinct entities or if they bleed together. Also, verify the eyes—are they symmetrical and do they have proper reflections? The red lips should be checked for symmetry and clean edges against the skin.
